sourceTypes.label: Web page
sourceTypes.description: A public web page or documentation page to read in a Wave web pane.

sourceTypes.label: Paper or report
sourceTypes.description: A publication, report, or long-form source that needs citation review.

sourceTypes.label: Local note reference
sourceTypes.description: A user-owned note or index entry; store only non-secret URLs here.

phases.label: Brief
phases.gate: Question, scope, exclusions, and expected output are explicit.

phases.label: Survey
phases.gate: Broad search terms, source types, and competing angles are recorded.

phases.label: Specialize
phases.gate: Bounded worker tasks have inputs, outputs, and stop conditions.

phases.label: Consolidate
phases.gate: Findings, rejected claims, and open questions are merged into session state.

phases.label: Verify
phases.gate: Claims are checked against sources for citation, freshness, and contradiction risk.

phases.label: Synthesize
phases.gate: Final answer is drafted only from accepted evidence or explicit uncertainty.

profiles.label: Orchestrator
profiles.description: Keeps the research brief, phase state, worker queue, and final handoff shape visible.

profiles.label: Source reader
profiles.description: Reads queued sources and records candidate claims with links and notes.

profiles.label: Skeptic
profiles.description: Looks for contradictions, weak sources, missing context, and unsupported jumps.

profiles.label: Citation checker
profiles.description: Checks whether final claims have stable, auditable source support.

profiles.label: Synthesizer
profiles.description: Drafts the final synthesis from accepted evidence and marked uncertainty.

copyableCommands.label: Open source in Wave web pane
copyableCommands.description: Copy this from a Wave-aware terminal if you want Wave to open the source in a web pane. The backend does not run wsh from LaunchAgent context.

copyableCommands.label: Start worker from current task
copyableCommands.description: Copy this prompt into your preferred Hermes-backed worker or agent pane.
